title: New Update Available
message: Admin test build. Build 14 with obfuscated release code and Claymorphism UI, chest, signup, coin shop, profile and voice-message fixes.
fixes: Fixed chest reopening after rewarded ad
Added Light and Dark themes with Light as default
Fixed Light theme colors on Leaderboard and Reels
Added compressed voice messages with one- or two-listen limit
Voice files are removed from Supabase Storage after final playback
Room owner profile picture now appears by default
Signup reward popup now appears on app open with a one-day Turn off option
